text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: elevated 5xx spike detected on gateway-prod. 5xx rate ~18% over 5m. Alerting @ryan (oncall).
ryan: Oncall here — acknowledging. Pulling traces and dashboards.
maya: seeing webhook delivery failures (customer-facing). Correlation ids I have: cf2a7e8f-9a, d1b3f5c2-3b. Sharing what I can.
ryan: can someone fetch gateway KV logs for corrid=cf2a7e8f and include upstream request ids? also ingress proxy logs around 12:10Z
oliver: grabbing KV logs + proxy traces, ETA ~2m
oliver: KV log excerpt for corrid=cf2a7e8f:
```
[2026-03-17T12:10:33Z] corrid=cf2a7e8f gateway->upstream=req-789 status=504 retry=1
[2026-03-17T12:10:34Z] corrid=cf2a7e8f upstream->gateway req-789 response_time=3200ms upstream_status=timeout
[2026-03-17T12:10:34Z] corrid=cf2a7e8f gateway retrying to upstream=req-790
[2026-03-17T12:10:36Z] corrid=cf2a7e8f gateway->client status=502
```
tessa: that looks like an upstream timeout followed by a retry that still fails — amplification risk.
ryan: do we have any recent config changes to retry policy? a bump in retries could amplify transient upstream slowness into higher 5xx.
ion: quick check — there was a config roll earlier today that changed `gateway.retry_limit` from 2 -> 3 for certain routes. PR #1427 merged at 10:45Z.
maya: customer-impact note: ~25 webhook integrations show failures in last 20m, CS paging a few accounts. Posting to ops-runbook.
ryan: mitigation plan: temporarily disable gateway retries for /v1/webhook and /v1/generate routes, enable fallback cache where available. I'll execute rollback flag now. @oliver monitor.
oliver: disabling retries flag in prod for affected routes: pushed feature-flag `gateway_retries=false` and reloaded config.
```
# feature flag toggle (prod)
PATCH /api/flags/gateway_retries
{ "value": false }
```
incident-bot: Mitigation applied. 5xx rate reduced to ~2% within ~4m of the flag toggle.
ryan: good. Please collect a full KV-log bundle and ingress traces for a 30m window (start ~12:00Z to 12:30Z). We'll assemble timeline + config diffs for RCA.
ion: assigned for RCA. Initial hypothesis: config change increasing retry_limit + one or two slow upstream pods → retry amplification and higher client 5xx. I'll include pod-level latency histograms, retry traces, and PR diff in the RCA doc.
ryan: thanks — once ion opens the RCA PR with timeline and log bundle, we'll close the page. :thumbsup:
ion: will post ETA for RCA doc in ~45m and attach S3 link to KV-log bundle and trace archive when ready.
